title: ESF 2026 VALORANT 香港公開賽
description: Open VALORANT tournament with HK$30,000 prize pool. 64-team cap, online qualifiers leading to offline LAN finals at the Hong Kong Computer & Communications Festival.
prize: HK$30,000 total (Champion HK$15,000 / Runner-up HK$9,000 / 3rd HK$6,000)

title: BLAST Rivals Season 2 Hong Kong
description: Premier international CS2 tournament returning to Hong Kong. 8 invited teams compete for $1M prize pool. Part of Asia Time CS2 cluster alongside IEM Beijing and PGL Singapore Major.

title: 觀塘區電子競技大賽暨體驗日 2026
description: Community esports event featuring CS2 2v2 mode plus other games (Valorant, FC, etc.). Organized by Kwun Tong Sports Promotion Association and EZK.GG. Free entry, open to all ages.
prize: Up to HK$1,000 in iTunes/Steam gift cards
organizer: Kwun Tong Sports Promotion Association x EZK.GG

title: Global Fast Track 2026 Pitching Competition
description: InvestHK's flagship startup pitching competition anchored around Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK. 8 verticals, virtual qualifiers, and grand finale. Minimum USD $250,000 revenue or investment required.
prize: Investment opportunities, business matching, market-entry support

title: Maker in China 2026 — 香港章
description: National-level SME innovation and entrepreneurship contest. 10 technology fields. Top 10 get investor matching, Cyberport incubation fast-track, and exhibition opportunities. Top 3 to global finals in Guangzhou.
prize: Top 3 advance to global finals; seed fund interview, incubation fast-track

title: 「未來香港」創科賽 2026
description: Innovation competition focused on AI and Web3.0 with dedicated AI image recognition track. Teams submit business plans with project videos. Total prize pool ~HK$6,400,000.
prize: Up to ~HK$6,400,000 in cash and prizes

title: 「共築．創業家2.0」青年創業計劃
description: Hong Kong Housing Authority programme offering rent-subsidized retail spaces in public housing estates to youth startups. 15 shops/kiosks plus 17 commercial partner slots. 3-year step-up rental model.
prize: 租金優惠商舖 + 商業夥伴轉介

title: AlipayHK αdvice 青年科創UX設計比賽 2026
title_en: AlipayHK αdvice Youth Tech UX Design Competition 2026
description: Youth innovation competition with secondary and tertiary streams. Design AI-integrated features for AlipayHK Super App. Winners visit Ant Group HQ in Hangzhou. Supported by Education Bureau.
prize: Junior Chief Innovation Officers + Hangzhou HQ trip
organizer: AlipayHK x SEED Foundation x HKFYG

title: HKSTP Ideation Programme (September 2026 Cohort)
description: Year-long startup support programme by HK Science Park. Up to HK$100,000 seed funding, co-working space, mentorship. Applications 3 times per year.
prize: Up to HK$100,000 seed funding + co-working space + mentorship

title: EZK Summer Showdown 2026 CS2
description: Hong Kong CS2 tournament with HK$120,000 first prize. Two stages: online qualifiers followed by LAN main event. Featured The MongolZ, Team Liquid, MOUZ.

title: ZOWIE Prodigy Series Season 2 CS2
title_en: ZOWIE Prodigy Series S2 CS2 HK
description: Hong Kong & Macau exclusive CS2 tournament with ZOWIE sponsorship. 32-team cap, online qualifiers to offline LAN finals. HK$11,000+ prize pool.

title: Qianhai GBA Youth Innovation & Entrepreneurship Competition (HK Region)
title_en: Qianhai GBA Youth Entrepreneurship Competition HK
description: Cross-border youth entrepreneurship competition encouraging GBA and cross-strait youth exchange. Hong Kong regional competition feeds into larger Qianhai competition.
prize: Cash prizes + incubation support + cross-border opportunities

title: HKUST-SINO One Million Dollar Entrepreneurship Competition 2026
description: HKUST's signature entrepreneurship competition. HKST Track and International Student Track. HK$400,000 platinum award. 2-10 member teams.
prize: HK$400,000 (Platinum) / HK$200,000 (Gold) / HK$100,000 (Silver)

title: 2026 HKU International Techno-Entrepreneurship Challenge
description: HKU's flagship deep tech entrepreneurship challenge with Start-up Track and Growth Track. Seed funding, investor connections, mentorship. Grand finale January 2027.
prize: Seed funding, VC access, mentorship, co-working spaces

title: Cyberport University Partnership Programme (CUPP) 2026
description: Flagship student entrepreneurship programme themed around AI, Blockchain, Cybersecurity, Data Science. 9-day overseas boot camp at LSE London. Top 10 teams: HK$100,000 seed each.
prize: HK$100,000 seed + LSE boot camp + Cyberport Incubation fast-track

title: Hong Kong Techathon+ 2026 (10th Edition)
description: 10th anniversary of HK's flagship university entrepreneurship competition. 1,900 innovators, 470+ teams, 4 themes. HK$1.4M+ seed funding pool. 15 universities participating.
prize: Over HK$1,400,000 seed funding

title: Physical AI Hackathon 2026 — Grand Finale
description: Hong Kong's first integrated software-hardware hackathon. Physical AI prototypes that sense, act, and transform the real world. 1,000+ applications from 240+ universities.
venue: 香港科學園 Charles K. Kao Auditorium
prize: Over HK$300,000 in prizes

title: BOCHK Challenge 2026 中銀香港創新先驅大賽
description: Bank of China (Hong Kong) innovation competition. Student Track and Startup Track. Focus on FinTech. Cross-university participation from HKU, CUHK, HKUST, PolyU, CityU, HKBU.
prize: Cash prizes + internship/fast-track opportunities

title: HKICT Awards 2026 — Student Innovation Award
description: 20th anniversary of HK's longest-running ICT award. Junior Secondary, Senior Secondary, Tertiary categories. 4 themes including AI Literacy, Open Data, Health & Well-being.
prize: Certificates + trophies; tertiary gold: CityU HK Tech 300 Seed Fund fast-track (up to HK$100,000)

title: 12th HK University Student Innovation & Entrepreneurship Competition
description: Major territory-wide university competition connecting to national and international contests. Innovation (science/tech) and Entrepreneurship categories. Pitching workshop May 15.
prize: Advancement to national competitions (Challenge Cup, China International College Students Innovation Competition)

title: HKSEC 2025-26 香港社會企業挑戰賽
description: HK's premier youth-led social venture competition since 2007. 184 submissions in 2026. Theme: YOUth Spark the Change! Up to HK$300,000 startup funding.
prize: Up to HK$300,000 startup funding + training + overseas exchange

title: Cyberport Creative Micro Fund (CCMF) — Oct 2026 Intake
description: Cyberport's core entrepreneurship programme: HK$100,000 seed for early-stage digital tech startups. Paired with 24-month Incubation Programme (up to HK$700,000).
prize: HK$100,000 seed (CCMF); up to HK$700,000 (CIP)

title: Hult Prize Hong Kong Summit 2026
description: World's largest student social enterprise competition. 17 semi-finalist teams at HKUST. Winning team advances toward global accelerator for USD $1M seed funding.
prize: Path to USD $1,000,000 global seed funding
organizer: Hult Prize Foundation / HKUST Entrepreneurship Center

title: FORMULA EDGE 校際AI賽車 2026
description: AI-powered autonomous racing competition for secondary schools across Greater Bay Area. 36 Jetracer teams from 13 schools. Combines coding, AI, and racing.
prize: Trophies and recognition

title: Esports Nations Cup 2026 — HK National Team
description: Inaugural multi-title nation-based esports competition (Olympics-style). HK qualified for League of Legends Play-ins. $1,500,000 USD prize pool.
prize: $1,500,000 USD (League of Legends)
